'drop_table':'self._get(name)\n        del self._tables[name]',
'has_table':'return name in self._tables',
'table_names':'return list(self._tables)',
'get_schema':'return self._get(name)[0]',
'insert':'schema, rows = self._get(name)\n        if len(row) != len(schema.columns):\n            raise TypeMismatchError(\n                f"expected {len(schema.columns)} values, got {len(row)}"\n            )\n        for column, value in zip(schema.columns, row):\n            if not value_matches_type(value, column.type):\n                raise TypeMismatchError(\n                    f"value {value!r} does not fit column {column.name} ({column.type.value})"\n                )\n        rows.append(tuple(row))',
'scan':'return iter(list(self._get(name)[1]))',
'delete_where':'_, rows = self._get(name)\n        kept = [r for r in rows if not predicate(r)]\n        removed = len(rows) - len(kept)\n        rows[:] = kept\n        return removed',
}
for k,b in bodies.items():
    s=re.sub(r'raise NotImplementedError\(f"\{self.__class__.__name__\}.%s not implemented"\)'%k,lambda m:b,s)
s=s.replace('    def create_table','''    def _get(self, name: str) -> tuple[Schema, list[Row]]:
        try:
            return self._tables[name]
        except KeyError:
            raise UnknownTableError(name) from None

    def create_table''',1)
open(p,'w').write(s)
EOF
